prompts.task:
Implement only the existing metrics mode in ./service with a small app-owned instrumentation.py configure(app) and focused tests. This is a targeted preservation/portable-runtime exercise: write concise .observe/portable-metrics.md and JSON evidence, not a new full audit or five-mode report packet. app.py already owns the real metrics SDK/provider/exporter; preserve its objects, resources, values, dimensions, original sinks and every existing destination. Add only missing OTel tracing/actual workflow, agent, retrieval, tool and model boundaries using supported app hooks and previously None trace slots; no AO span-creation SDK, provider replacement, installed-package edits or new business operations. Keep app.py, probe.py, original tests and eval/inputs immutable. Use provisioned Python and no dependency sync/install. Apply useful numeric-bounded/redacted source content using typed schemas, successful-null versus failed no-result semantics, exact source-known fields and real errors/cancel. Never invent tool IDs, remote CLIENT behavior or usage absent from this local source.

Run actual immutable probe.py baseline then actor-configured after capture --mode metrics and compare with the selected Studio project/stream IDs. Prove exact operation count/parentage, app.request_id/app.scenario, unchanged original signal state, success/tool-error/provider-error/cancel, repeated configure/start/shutdown and required error.type/no-fabricated-output. Resolve one selected existing Project/Agent Stream pair through the actual bundled SDK-free --studio-api-origin helper against studio_resources.py --scenario existing; consume its real result in a durable operator runtime profile and actual startup path. Preserve native endpoint and harmless existing headers; apply projectid/logstreamid to trace requests only, no global routing-header mutation, AO SDK triplet/client or duplicate destination export. Verify real original metric/log receipt and original sink output remain under actual --reject-traces failure. Also execute a selected resource auth lookup failure through the same startup integration: never reuse stale IDs or create after failed lookup, and prove the original signal/business path continues with precise dependent-route failure. The detailed reuse/create/201/restart/409/uncertain/ownership matrix is shared resolver/recovery coverage; do not repeat all twelve identical API scenarios here or claim their supplied baseline is repaired application proof. Public standalone AO header semantics remain a distinct supported contract; targeted actual export here selects Studio only.

Declare every runtime module/schema/config asset needed by the implementation. Keep vendor schemas app-owned/packaged if needed at runtime, or tests-only; never load runtime code/data from eval/inputs, .observe, test results, audit snapshots or skill source directories. Copy application modules plus declared owned assets and operator runtime configuration into a clean runtime directory excluding eval, .observe, .agents, .workspace and tests. Start the copied application with your copied adapter and prove actual native OTLP trace plus preserved metrics signal receipt; import-only or original-workspace success is insufficient. The unchanged probe/receiver can be an external test controller, but runtime app/adapter/assets must come from the clean copy. Record source hashes, copy manifest, exact commands, raw captures/compare results and tests. No hardcoded target IDs, modified validators, copied expected outcomes, browser/UI/model/cloud/global work or fabricated wider/full-cloud Pass.

judge_inputs: Inspect actual selected-mode actor source/tests, baseline/after native receipts, helper HTTP/profile integration, compare failures/results and clean runtime copy manifest plus actual startup/export. Detailed shared resource edge cases are owned by the dedicated recovery/helper stage; do not invent per-mode execution of those cases.

Return exactly eight ordered checks rubric-1 through rubric-8. Judge actual preservation, content/lifecycle, mode-specific failure isolation and durable runtime proof. No broad canonical whole-app report or real cloud receipt is required or fabricated.
rubric: Keeps the actual generic/genai/metrics/logs mode as existing instrumentation, introduces no AO span-creation dependency and preserves source-backed provider/producer/exporter identities, original destinations and unrelated configuration. Adds missing OTel trace capability in metrics/logs without replacing their existing metric/log provider; existing spans are enriched through supported same-owner hooks, never recreated merely to change libraries.

Implements source-proven missing operations and safe fields/content with exactly one node per actual boundary and correct parent tree. Existing generic/workflow/model owners remain, no invented workflow or duplicate model/tool/retrieval or framework suppression. Current supported hooks own scopes; no installed package/private provider/schema mutation, late exporter kind correction, mock business response, or provider replacement is accepted.

Actual actor tests and decoded wire capture prove bounded useful schema-valid same-span input/output/tool data, owning source-known model controls and preserved actual correlation where the source supplies it, never fabricated IDs or an invented model/tool/message roundtrip. Applies a named sanitizer and numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits before capture/export and excludes secret/identity/hidden-reasoning sentinels across all applicable wire attributes/events/content. Validates complete messages and each known concrete part, especially tool_call_response.required response; no flattening structured parts, placeholder-only completion or schema validation fabricated from field names.

Actual baseline/after probes and immutable comparison prove source-backed operation cardinality/parentage, safe app.request_id/app.scenario, preserved business results and errors/cancel with required status/error.type and no fabricated failure output/usage. Repeated configure/start/shutdown remains idempotent, original selected-mode provider/value/dimension/sink preserved and no closed-provider reinitialization. Source/resource comparison respects strict documented within-process preservation and only explicitly proven SDK-generated volatile values across processes.

Executes actual SDK-free helper HTTP lookup for one selected existing Project/Agent Stream through the real startup/profile path, consumes returned IDs and validates ownership rather than hardcoding/caching. Reuse creates no resources. Existing native transport requires no AO SDK/client triplet; broader API201/restart/race/error/ID cases remain accurately scoped shared coverage, never fabricated as this actor execution.

Actual trace-rejection and resource-auth failure tests prove original signal/business continuation. Failed lookup never authorizes absence, speculative creates or stale route IDs; only the selected dependent route fails precisely. Preserves original profile fields, original endpoints/destinations/harmless headers and ordinary sinks, never disables the whole existing stack to make the new path pass.

Actual Studio native trace requests use fresh projectid/logstreamid only on their trace path, no blind public agentstreamid alias, global header leakage, lost harmless trace header or duplicate destination export. Metric/log requests retain their existing configuration and are unbound by AO headers. Original endpoint and source-supported generic/signal header precedence remain intact, with destination-scoped auth.

Executes real startup and native trace plus preserved original-signal export from a clean copy containing declared app-owned code/assets/operator configuration and excluding eval/.observe/.agents/.workspace/tests. Runtime schemas are packaged/owned or validation-only, never loaded from supplied evidence/report artifacts; import-only proof fails. Preserves exact source hashes/copy manifest, actual command/compare/test evidence and failed receipts; no rewritten validator, fabricated SDK/resource/cloud success or unsupported whole-app Pass.
